title: Soil Conservation Measures
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Agriculture; not yet checked by a CBC Agriculture teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Lay a stone line or trash line along a contour marked with an A-frame on the school slope, plant a grass strip, and build a farm model in a carton showing all five measures.

skills.key_step: The child names methods of soil conservation and what each does: strip cropping, grassed waterways, stone lines, trash lines, soil bunds, terraces, contour farming, mulching, cover crops, agroforestry.

floor.question: How should a slope be ploughed?

representations: a farm model in a carton
steps: Say how it slows water or covers soil.

board.do: Draw a slope with lines of stones across it.

board.say: What do they do to the water?

board.do: Wait for "slow it and trap soil".

misconceptions.ask: What does terracing do on a slope?
misconceptions.repair: Pour water down a tray with and without small steps of soil; time it.

misconceptions.ask: What does mulch do to soil?
misconceptions.repair: Lay mulch on a tray and show it covering the soil from raindrops.

misconceptions.ask: How should crops be planted on a slope?
misconceptions.repair: Recall Grade 6: rows across the slope stop water; rows down the slope become channels.

listen_for: Burn them to clear the field
misconceptions.ask: What can be done with maize stalks after harvest to conserve soil?
misconceptions.repair: Show a trash line holding soil behind it after rain.

checks.question: Name two soil conservation measures.
checks.answer: any two of strip cropping, grassed waterways, stone lines, trash lines, bunds, terraces

checks.question: How do trash lines conserve soil?
checks.answer: they slow water and trap soil

skills.key_step: The child says how measures are carried out: mark the contour with an A-frame, lay stone or trash lines and build bunds along it, plant strips across the slope, grass the waterway, repair after storms.
representations: an A-frame made of sticks and a stone on a string
steps: Mark the contour with an A-frame.
Lay lines or build bunds along it.

board.do: Draw an A-frame on a slope.
Ask what the hanging stone shows when the legs are level.
Wait for "it hangs at the middle mark".

misconceptions.ask: How is a stone line laid on a slope?
misconceptions.repair: Pour water along a tilted line on a model; it runs to the low end and cuts a gully.

misconceptions.ask: Why is a waterway planted with grass?
misconceptions.repair: Run water down a bare channel and a grassed channel on a model.

misconceptions.ask: How are strips laid out in strip cropping?
misconceptions.repair: Draw both on a slope and trace where rain water goes.

misconceptions.ask: What must be done to soil bunds after a heavy storm?
misconceptions.repair: Show a broken bund with a gully below the break.

checks.question: What tool marks a contour on a slope?
Why plant grass in a waterway?
